title: Nested countable Borel partitions of a separable metric space with mesh 1/(i+1)
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X], ∃ P : ℕ → ℕ → Set X, (∀ i j, MeasurableSet (P i j)) ∧ (∀ i j k, j ≠ k → Disjoint (P i j) (P i k)) ∧ (∀ i, ⋃ j, P i j = Set.univ) ∧ (∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ P i j, ∀ x' ∈ P i j, dist x x' < 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (∀ i j, ∃ k, P (i + 1) j ⊆ P i k)
